test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held on: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In the following sentence, four words are underlined, out of which one word is incorrectly spelt. Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word.

A lot of __spontanity__ is required from the speaker in an __extempore__ speech. The speaker is expected to __brainstorm__ ideas and give speech __instantaneously__.
solution:
The correct answer is "**spontanity**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The word "spontanity" is misspelled because it is missing the letter "e". The correct spelling is "spontaneity."**
 
• **Spontaneity means the quality of being spontaneous or natural, without any planning or preparation.**
 
 
• Example: She occasionally tore up her usual schedule in favor of spontaneity
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, the speaker is expected to exhibit spontaneity while delivering an extempore speech.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 - '**instantaneously'** is spelled correctly and means 'in an instant; immediately'.
 
• Option 2 - **'extempore**' is spelled correctly and means 'spoken or done without preparation'.
 
• Option 3 -** 'brainstorm' **is spelled correctly and means 'to generate or come up with ideas through a group discussion'.
